behavior.name: 0x1300075c
behavior.description: A warp point with a configurable hitbox radius. The radius is determined by the first behavior parameter: a value of 0 sets it to 85, 0xFF sets it to 10000, and other values are multiplied by 10. It resets its interaction status every frame.

field.name: Radius
field.description: Radius of the warp's hitbox. 0 is default (85), 0xFF is huge (10000), otherwise multiplied by 10.
